name: Filesystem (reference server)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C5, C8; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.3.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 2.3.0 is dated 2026-11-11; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-12.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 8 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list for @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (2.3.0). Most recent: GHSA-7m4x-rv66-mxhh (medium, published 2026-11-11, patched in 2.3.0).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Access is confined to the directories given at start-up; write tools are served unless `--read-only` is added. Quoted: “The server may touch only its **allowed directories**.”; “Add `--read-only` to serve only the tools that cannot change the filesystem:”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented setup takes no credential. Searched `src/filesystem/README.md` for: API_KEY, _TOKEN\b, password.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `src/filesystem/README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `src/filesystem/README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/server ^2.3.1. Lower-bound version 2.3.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/server (npm) was published on 2026-10-05, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
